## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## ❓ Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? 
*Example: "I always want to add text annotations over my screen drawings, but currently I can only draw freehand lines and shapes."*

## 🎨 Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working in the app (e.g. new floating toolbar button, color picker option, gesture controls).

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🖼️ Mockups / Visual Examples
If you have UI wireframes, mockups, or screenshots from other apps showing similar functionality, please attach them here.

## 🎯 Target Audience
Who would benefit most from this feature? (e.g., Teachers, Students, Gamers, Presenters)
